items.title: Low pressure Dave spoils Easter with wind and snow
items.summary: A troublesome Easter weather awaits with a deep low pressure on its way in - towards Easter day there may be warnings, according to SMHI's meteorologist. - It looks a bit messy on Sunday actually and really windy in Götaland in particular, says Anna Belking.
items.title_original: Lågtrycket Dave sabbar påsken med blåst och snö
items.summary_original: Ett besvärligt påskväder väntar med ett djupt lågtryck på intåg – framåt påskdagen kan det bli tal om varningar, enligt SMHI:s meteorolog. – Det ser lite stökigt ut på söndagen faktiskt och riktigt blåsigt i framförallt Götaland, säger Anna Belking.

items.title: Mjällby stronger - even though the golden heroes are gone
items.summary: Since the SM gold last autumn, Mjällby has lost several key players, changed coaches - and somehow become even stronger. The barking team from Listerlandet has flown through the pre-season and reached the final in the Swedish Cup. Is there any stopping the reigning champions?
items.title_original: Mjällby starkare – trots att guldhjältarna är borta
items.summary_original: Sedan SM-guldet i höstas har Mjällby blivit av med flera nyckelspelare, bytt tränare – och på något sätt blivit ännu starkare. Skrällaget från Listerlandet har flugit fram genom försäsongen och gått till final i Svenska cupen. Finns det något stopp för de regerande mästarna?

items.title: Six profiles to keep an eye on in Hammarby-Mjällby
items.summary: On Saturday afternoon, the Allsvenskan is back again after the winter break. The series starts with a big meeting right away when the reigning champions Mjällby are pitted against Hammarby in Stockholm. Here are three profiles in each team to keep an extra eye on during the match.
items.title_original: Sex profiler att ha koll på i Hammarby-Mjällby
items.summary_original: Under lördagseftermiddagen är allsvenskan tillbaka igen efter vinteruppehållet. Serien startar med ett stormöte direkt när de regerande mästarna Mjällby ställs mot Hammarby i Stockholm. Här är tre profiler i varje lag att ha ett extra öga på under matchen.

items.title: Minister for Rural Affairs Peter Kullgren welcomes Germany to For Forest+
items.summary: Sweden is this year’s chair of the For Forest+ group. In this context, Minister for Rural Affairs Peter Kullgren hosted a meeting of the group’s members on 31 March, during which the group welcomed Germany as a new member. With the addition of Germany, For Forest+ now consists of eight EU Member States that collectively account for around 60 per cent of the forests of the 27 EU Member States (EU27).

items.title: SEK 240 million in new support to Ukraine
items.summary: The Government has presented a new support package to Ukraine for 2026 worth around SEK 240 million. The support includes SEK 150 million for the Ukrainian Red Cross for humanitarian operations. In addition, the support package is heavily focused on children’s needs, supporting the provision of school food in areas close to the frontline, promoting reforms for family-based care of children and supporting children’s mental health.

items.title: SEK 555 million in new humanitarian aid for Gaza
items.summary: After more than two years of war and suffering, children in Gaza are in acute need of health and medical care, psychosocial support, safety, nutrition and education. Initiatives in these areas are needed to lay the foundations for reconstruction and recovery. Sweden is now providing SEK 555 million in aid, which will be distributed between the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF), the UN World Food Programme (WFP) and the United Nations Development Programme, and will help bring safety, stability and well-being to children in Gaza.
